Definition: Does the government maintain a digital civil register?
Comments: Kenya has an electronic CRVS database (CRVSS) but UN CRVSID reports it is largely limited (e.g., Nairobi and offline workflows elsewhere), while 2025-2026 initiatives and legislation aim to modernize/digitize civil registration—indicating partial deployment.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Kenya’s Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) maintains an electronic register of voters and operates digital voter verification/registration systems (e.g., voter verification portal and KIEMS/BVR), indicating nationwide deployment of a digital electoral register.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital land register?
Comments: Kenya’s Ministry of Lands operates ArdhiSasa (NLIMS) as an online land administration/registration platform, but official communications show it is being onboarded county/block by county/block (e.g., Isiolo blocks live in 2025), indicating partial deployment rather than fully nationwide.
